function.name: retrieveKnowledge
function.description: Search the bank's knowledge base for FAQ answers, step-by-step procedures, or terms and conditions matching the user's question. Always call this before answering any banking-specific question.

query.description: The user's question, rephrased as a clean search query.

category.description: Optional category to narrow the search, e.g. credit_card, fraud, password_access, terms_and_conditions. Leave blank if unsure.
